description: Login and Registro UI components in apps/macros-web, reusing the Enchanted/Cozy design tokens and primitives (FormCard, PrimaryButton/SecondaryButton) and a shared email/password field built on the TextField pattern. Forms use react-hook-form + zodResolver with the FEAT-002 schemas and show per-field errors. Submit handlers are READY for a future API/Supabase call via an injectable onSubmit callback; the default handler logs ONLY a redacted/validated-shape object (email + password length, NEVER the raw password) through a tiny injectable logger so ESLint no-console stays green. On successful login/registro the handler persists a placeholder session token via useAuthStorage (FEAT-001). Wire an auth view-switcher into App.tsx so both screens are reachable. Add integration tests (validation errors, Registro password-match, successful submit invokes handler with validated data and no raw password) and a Playwright E2E for the login happy path. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Create apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/components/AuthField.tsx: a labelled input for email/password built on the existing TextField styling (border-cardBorder, focus:border-sage focus:ring-sage/30, text-ink). Accept type ('email'|'password'), autoComplete, register (UseFormRegisterReturn), error. Reuse aria-invalid/aria-describedby + role='alert' error wiring.

Create apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/types.ts: export AuthSubmitLogger type and a default redactLogger that logs { email, passwordLength } via a provided sink; export AuthHandlers types. Ensure NO raw password is included.

Create apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/LoginForm.tsx: useForm<LoginValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(loginSchema), mode: 'onTouched', defaultValues: loginDefaults }); render inside FormCard with Playfair title (font-serif text-ink) + muted subtitle; AuthField for email + password; PrimaryButton type='submit' with hover lift; onSubmit prop (defaulted) persists token via useAuthStorage and calls the redacted logger. Function < 50 lines; immutable.
Create apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/RegisterForm.tsx: analogous with RegisterValues/registerSchema and the confirmPassword AuthField; cross-field error renders on confirmPassword.

Create apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/AuthScreen.tsx: holds useState for 'login'|'register', renders the active form inside the cream background layout (bg-cream, centered) and a SecondaryButton/link to switch modes using copy.es strings.

Update apps/macros-web/src/App.tsx (or a small router/entry) so AuthScreen is reachable. Keep the existing MacrosWizard reachable too (e.g. simple top-level nav/state) so Module 2 is not removed. Do not add react-router unless necessary; a minimal state switch is acceptable.

Write apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/__tests__/LoginForm.test.tsx: shows email+password errors on empty submit; successful submit (valid email+password) invokes the injected onSubmit/logger spy with a redacted object (email + passwordLength) and NOT the raw password; token saved via a mocked storage.

Write apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/__tests__/RegisterForm.test.tsx: mismatched passwords show 'Las contraseñas no coinciden.' on confirmPassword and block submit; matching passwords submit and invoke the handler with validated data; raw password never passed to the logger.

Add apps/macros-web/e2e/auth.spec.ts: Playwright happy path - open the login screen, fill valid email+password, submit, assert a success/state change; switch to Registro and assert the confirm-password field is visible.
Run full typecheck, lint, unit+integration tests with coverage, build, and E2E.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting an empty Login form shows Spanish email and password validation errors; no submit handler fires.
Submitting Registro with mismatched passwords shows 'Las contraseñas no coinciden.' on the confirmPassword field and blocks submit.
A valid submit invokes the injectable handler with the validated data and logs ONLY a redacted object (email + passwordLength), never the raw password; a mocked token storage receives a token.

Login and Registro screens render with the exact design tokens (bg-cream, FormCard translucent card + backdrop-blur, sage focus border, Playfair titles) and are reachable from App.tsx without removing the Macros wizard.
npm run typecheck, npm run lint (no-console clean), npm run test -- --run (>=80% coverage on auth files), and npm run build all pass. Playwright auth E2E passes if the environment allows.
findings: Implemented in apps/macros-web/src/features/auth: AuthField (email/password input on the TextField pattern), types.ts (AuthSubmitHandler<T>, RedactedCredentials, redactCredentials, noopAuthLogger default sink), useAuthSubmit hook (shared submit: logs ONLY redacted creds, persists a non-secret 'session-<ts>' placeholder via useAuthStorage, success/error state), LoginForm, RegisterForm (confirmPassword + cross-field mismatch), AuthScreen (login/register toggle). App.tsx gained a minimal useState view switch (Calculadora de macros / Cuenta) keeping MacrosWizard; no react-router added. Resolved the console.log-vs-no-console tension with a zero-disable injectable logger (default no-op) so the 'validated data log' is wired and ready for API/Supabase without any console call. Tests: LoginForm (4), RegisterForm (3), AuthScreen (2) all green; raw password asserted never in logger args via JSON.stringify; mocked saveToken receives a 'session-<digits>' token. VERIFY RESULTS: `npm run test -- --run src/features/auth` => 9 files / 42 tests pass; coverage of src/features/auth = 96.56% stmts, 81.25% branches, 100% funcs (>=80%). `npm run lint` clean (no-console green, zero disables). Isolated tsc on the 6 auth source files is type-clean. PRE-EXISTING (not my regression): full `npm run typecheck`/`npm run build` fail only on the @energy alias (Module-1 energy domain absent on this branch) and the Module-1/2 files importing it; none of my auth files appear in the errors. Because playwright.config webServer runs `npm run build` (tsc first), `npm run test:e2e` cannot start the preview on this branch state (webServer exit code 2) — this is the documented pre-existing @energy issue. The e2e/auth.spec.ts file is correct and valid (confirmed via `playwright test --list`); it was NOT deleted. Branch base containing both Module 1 and Module 2 will make the full build/typecheck/E2E green.
